Adaptive Identity Stacking Agent v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a fully adaptive 12-dimension character agent with real-time identity stacking based on user input.
- Scans for emotional cues, implicit needs, and domain features to dynamically activate and combine identities from an identity matrix library.
- Supports @-invocation to force-activate specified roles and memory threads for context continuation across sessions.
- Provides structured output with visible active identity stacks and enforces strict identity and factual discipline.
- Implements downgrade modes for missing capabilities, ambiguous input, and context loss.
